statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, dizziness, and fatigue
The patient has paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has sick sinus syndrome
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is needed to correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances
Diagnosis codes I48.0, I34.0, and I49.5 were used
The denial reason was that required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before the service was rendered
